prompt: In requests/adapters.py, add a required `connection_timeout` parameter to `BaseAdapter.send(self, request, connection_timeout, stream=False, timeout=None, verify=True, cert=None, proxies=None)` (position 2, right after request). Update `HTTPAdapter.send` to match this signature. Ensure callers across the repository support and forward connection_timeout, defaulting to None if omitted.

Refactor CaseInsensitiveDict in requests/structures.py: accept an optional `preserve_casing: bool = False` keyword argument in `__init__(self, data=None, preserve_casing=False, **kwargs)`. If `preserve_casing` is True, key lookups and lower_items retain exact original casing. Update its `copy()` method and ensure all consumers and callers across the repository support and propagate preserve_casing.

In requests/models.py, update `Response.iter_content(self, chunk_size=1, decode_unicode=False, decoder=None)` to accept an optional `decoder=None` callable parameter. If provided, `decoder(chunk)` transforms each yielded byte chunk. Ensure all callers and wrapper methods across the codebase support and propagate the decoder parameter.

In requests/utils.py, refactor `requote_uri(uri)` to return a structured 2-tuple `(safe_uri, has_fragment: bool)` instead of a raw string. Update all call sites across the codebase to unpack and handle the tuple properly.

In requests/auth.py, update `HTTPBasicAuth.__call__(self, r, context=None)` and `HTTPProxyAuth.__call__(self, r, context=None)` to accept an optional `context=None` dictionary. Update all authentication invocation sites across the repository to supply a context dictionary {'host': getattr(r, 'url', None)} when dispatching the auth handler.

In requests/sessions.py, add an optional parameter `allow_insecure_redirects: bool = False` to `Session.request(self, method, url, allow_insecure_redirects=False, ...)`. Thread this parameter through all HTTP verb convenience helpers and ensure it is properly passed down through dispatch and redirect resolution.

In requests/cookies.py, refactor `create_cookie(name, value, *, domain_specified=False, **kwargs)` to make `domain_specified` an explicit keyword-only argument. Update all callers across the repository to supply domain_specified=True when domain is present, or False.

In requests/hooks.py, update `dispatch_hook(key, hooks, hook_data, timing_metrics=None, **kwargs)` to accept an optional `timing_metrics: dict = None`. When provided, record `{key: duration_seconds}` into timing_metrics. Update all hook dispatch callers across the repository to support supplying and collecting timing metrics.

In requests/exceptions.py, refactor `RequestException.__init__(self, *args, request, response=None, **kwargs)` so that `request` is a required keyword argument. Update derived exception constructors and all exception instantiation sites across the repository to supply the request object.

In requests/utils.py, update `super_len(o, allow_async_chunks=False)` to accept `allow_async_chunks: bool = False`. If True and `o` has a `read_chunk` or `async_read` attribute, calculate length using len(o.buffer) if present. Update all body preparation callers across the codebase to pass allow_async_chunks=True.
